title: Noise-Aware Testing of NISQ Quantum Programs: Self-Baseline Oracle with a Controlled False-Positive Rate
abstract: arXiv:2611.20613v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Testing quantum programs on Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices faces a test-oracle problem: hardware noise and finite-shot sampling make the runs of a correct program vary as much as those of a faulty one, so oracles with a fixed acceptance threshold produce false positives that depend on the program and the backend. We present a noise-aware testing framework built on self-baseline calibration: each run of the program under test is compared with repeated executions of a trusted reference program on the same backend, and the acceptance threshold is the $(1-\alpha)$ quantile of the finite-shot null distribution of the Jensen-Shannon divergence, so the oracle's false-positive rate is a level set in advance. A noncentral chi-square model predicts detection power, a homogeneity test and a two-run sentinel detect drift, a mutation engine labels every mutant exactly within a three-class noise-aware taxonomy, and zero-noise extrap

translated_title: 噪声感知的NISQ量子程序测试：具有可控假阳性率的自基线测试预言机
translated_abstract: 在噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）设备上测试量子程序面临一个测试预言机问题：硬件噪声和有限次数采样使得正确程序的运行结果波动程度与错误程序相当，因此采用固定接受阈值的预言机所产生的假阳性会依赖于具体程序和后端。我们提出了一个基于自基线校准的噪声感知测试框架：被测程序的每次运行都与在同一后端上重复执行的受信任参考程序进行比较，接受阈值取Jensen-Shannon散度有限次数零假设分布的$(1-\alpha)$分位数，从而使预言机的假阳性率成为可预先设定的水平。一个非中心卡方模型用于预测检测功效，同质性检验和双运行哨兵机制用于检测漂移，一个变异引擎在三分类噪声感知分类体系内对每个变异体进行精确标注，零噪声外推……（摘要不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于自基线校准的噪声感知NISQ量子程序测试框架，以可信参考程序在同一后端上的重复执行作为对照，并利用Jensen-Shannon散度有限采样零分布的分位数作为接受阈值，从而实现假阳性率的预先设定与可控。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a noise-aware testing framework for NISQ quantum programs built on self-baseline calibration, where the program under test is compared against repeated executions of a trusted reference program on the same backend, with the acceptance threshold derived from the finite-shot null distribution of the Jensen-Shannon divergence to achieve a pre-set and controllable false-positive rate.
